name: dsh-think-fold
description: Auto-expands the row that is running and folds it back when it settles. While a turn runs, its whole procedure sits in one height-capped window that scrolls itself; when the turn finishes, it merges into the built-in process header — narration included, only the final answer left on screen. Client-only, zero custom rendering: layout, code blocks and diffs are all the official ones. 当前正在执行的那一条自动展开、执行完自动收起；跑着的一轮把整段过程收进一个限高窗口自己滚到最新；一轮跑完再把整轮过程（连同中间旁白）并成一条「已完成 · 用时」，只留最终回复。
author: Citrusrr
